name: @sshadows/bc-toolbox-envelope
description: Shared machine envelope for the bc-toolbox: MCP isError body and CLI --json envelope, with stable error codes and JSON Schemas

scripts.build: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && bun build src/index.ts --target=node --external zod --outdir dist && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run typecheck && bun test && bun run build
